integrity: The proof is symbolic and uses only Legendre valuation and a direct exceptional-case residue computation. Finite code checks are supplementary and are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to odd prime powers p^r with r>=2 and p not dividing a; it does not classify the 2-adic case, the prime case r=1, nonunit parameters, or composite-support inputs.
title: Sharp odd-prime-power valuation of the Moser–Moser sum
